exactDynamicWriteWorkflow: 1. Apply Pin Logic: FLMD0/MODE=HIGH (+5V) via DTR=false, RESET Pulse=100ms, settle=150ms.
2. Connect & Wake: 9600 bps 8N1; execute wake-up (0x00 (10ms) 0x00 + 01 01 00 FF 03) and confirm ACK (0x06).

3. Auto-ID & Geometry: Wake via [Pattern 1: Framed (NEC/Renesas 78K0/RL78: 0x00+0x00 -> SOH Reset 0x00)] @ 9600 8N1 -> query universal ID opcodes [0xC0,0xC5,0xFB,0x01,0x02,0x00,0x9F,0xAF] -> matched: 0xC0->|78F1 , 0xC5->00 00 00 02 01 00, 0x00->02 01 06 F9 03 -> Range=0x000000..0x007FFF (Fallback), Block=1024B, Page=256B.

4. Lock Oscillator & Speed: 0x90 crystal matrix probed (45 entries) without 0x06 ACK — target uses locked internal clock. (winning=--) | Connect at 9600 8N1 -> lock 0x90 (--) -> send 0x9A [code] -> wait 25ms -> reconfigure host UART -> confirm 0x00 Ping -> Supported: 9600 bps.
5. Blank Check / Erase: send 0x32 (Blank Check) or Erase via 0x20 (Chip Erase) / 0x22 (Block Erase) and wait 450ms busy timeout.

6. Program Flash (0x40): send Start..End (Big-Endian (24-bit: Addr_H, Addr_M, Addr_L)), wait 23ms, stream STX (0x02) frames of 256B ending with ETB (0x17) on intermediate pages and ETX (0x03) on final page (120ms gap).
7. Verify & Sign-off: verify written data via 0x13 (Verify) and confirm Full-Flash 0xB0 Checksum.
